description: UNDERSTANDING — Re-run one of your saved searches against the live catalog and return current matching providers. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

id.description: Saved search id, as save_search returns it or list_saved_searches lists it.

name: run_saved_search
